title: A freshly exported Product Group Override CSV cannot be re-imported: one empty-Override-Price row aborts that row
stepsToReproduce: Open Corporate Pricing > Product Group Override on a healthy office (e.g. 4107) and select the location.
Click Export to download the tenant-wide CSV (ProductGroupOverrides_<timestamp>UTC.csv).
Without editing the file, open the Import dialog, attach the raw exported CSV, and click Upload.
expectedBehavior: A file the application itself just exported should be re-importable without manual editing (export/import round-trip integrity).
actualBehavior: The import is rejected with 'Error Row#:N, Msg: LocationId, ProductGroupId, OverridePrice is required.' The raw export contains exactly one row with an empty Override Price (observed at export line 19: 1115,286,01D Double Screen Set Kit,0,USD,0.00,,,0), and the import's required-field validation refuses that row, so a naive export-then-import fails until the empty-price row is removed.
mcpEvidence: Live-verified 2026-07-23 on office 4107: the downloaded export content contains the empty-Override-Price row prefixed '1115,286,'; attaching the raw export and clicking Upload surfaces the required-field alert; the grid is unchanged after reload (full rollback). Covered by test case TC-CPR-OVR-054.
baselineEvidence: The Product Group Override import is net-new on this environment with no legacy-site equivalent; classified from live application DOM and network evidence, not a legacy regression.
